themes.description: Suggestions for new features or improvements to existing platform functionalities.
This theme covers requests for new trading functionalities, tools, order types, or enhancements to existing trading features within the application.
This theme covers complaints about excessive formalities, complex procedures, or difficult processes within the app or service.
This theme covers requests for new features, enhancements to existing functionalities, or complaints about missing app capabilities.
This theme covers feedback related to the app's design, layout, navigation, and overall user experience.
This theme covers issues related to the frequency, necessity, or impact of application updates on user experience.
Suggestions for new features, enhancements, or modifications to existing functionalities within the application.
Issues or questions related to account setup, verification, profile management, and general account operations.
This theme covers problems related to app accessibility for users with disabilities, including compatibility with assistive technologies.
This theme captures general feedback on the app's suitability for different user levels or trading styles, rather than specific technical issues.
This theme covers requests or feedback related to the availability of the app or its content in different regional languages.
This theme captures feedback regarding the app's appropriateness or features for different user levels or trading styles.
Reviews expressing general positive sentiment, happiness, or overall satisfaction with the service or platform.
Feedback related to the ease of use, intuitiveness, and overall user experience of the application or service.
Feedback or requests related to available investment products, asset classes, or foreign investment opportunities.
Issues related to downloading, installing, or initially accessing the application.
Issues related to account creation, login, access restrictions, or mandatory information requirements for using the platform.
This theme covers issues related to account creation, login, mandatory document submission (KYC), and general access restrictions within the application.
Issues related to account creation, KYC requirements, document submission, or initial access to the platform.
This theme covers issues related to the process of opening, activating, or verifying an account, including documentation requirements and delays in account status changes.
This theme covers complaints related to the application's user interface, design, layout, display, and overall user experience, including optimization for different devices.
